args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT setting to local setup instructions
args.body:
File: docs/RUNNING_LOCALLY.md

Include a step in the local setup instructions to set the environment variable S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO, as discussed by the reporter and maintainer. This aligns the instructions with the documented environment variable in docs/CONFIG.md.
